target.title: fix(codex): type app-server error classification
target.body:
Closes #99270

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Codex app-server harness control flow depended on `Error.message` prose for version fallback, startup shared-client cleanup, EPIPE handling, and native compaction stale-binding recovery.

## Why This Change Was Made

Harness-local control-flow errors now use typed `Error` subclasses and `instanceof` checks, so rewording their messages does not silently change behavior. Codex missing-thread compaction recovery now first requires the structured app-server RPC error code `-32600`, with the remaining `thread not found` prose match isolated to the Codex adapter because the checked Codex app-server source does not expose a dedicated missing-thread discriminant.

## User Impact

Codex app-server fallback, shared-client teardown, and stale binding recovery are less fragile. Plain errors with similar text no longer masquerade as harness control-flow signals, while existing user-facing messages are preserved.

## Evidence

- Codex dependency source checked at `../codex` SHA `129ea2aaf5fb426d8ba683ee53f290742f41dd31`:
  - `codex-rs/app-server/src/error_code.rs:3` defines invalid request as JSON-RPC `-32600`.
  - `codex-rs/app-server/src/error_code.rs:10-12` builds invalid-request JSON-RPC errors.
  - `codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/thread_processor.rs:1771-1782` loads the compact target thread before submitting compaction.
  - `codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/thread_processor.rs:4217-4221` maps missing threads to `invalid_request("thread not found: ...")`.
  - `codex-rs/app-server/tests/suite/v2/compaction.rs:344-375` asserts unknown compact threads return `-32600` and contain `thread not found`.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/client.test.ts` passed: 29 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/attempt-startup.test.ts` passed: 9 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/compact.test.ts` passed: 24 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.test.ts -- -t "retires the shared Codex client when a spawned helper hits a thread/start write failure"` passed: 1 test.
- `node_modules\.bin\oxfmt --check extensions/codex/src/app-server/errors.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/client.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/attempt-startup.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/compact.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/client.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/attempt-startup.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/compact.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.test.ts` passed.
- `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.
- `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local` reported no accepted/actionable findings in the worker lane.

Proof gaps:
- Full `run-attempt.test.ts` did not complete usefully locally; the exact touched EPIPE regression test passed.
- No live Codex app-server process proof was run; this is source-backed and focused-test-backed.
